caption: The drawing depicts a large ceramic jug with a rounded, bulbous body and a narrow, short neck terminating in a slightly flared rim. There is a single, curved handle attached near the top on one side. The jug is predominantly tan or light brown in color, with a smooth, matte surface that shows some gradient and shading to suggest volume and texture. On the front of the jug, there is a blue decorative motif resembling a stylized flower, from which symmetrical blue lines radiate outward and downward. Above the decoration, there is blue and white text, as well as embossed markings that appear to indicate the capacity ("5.") and possibly the manufacturer or location. The jug is set against a plain, light beige background with no other objects present.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
